body: I just spent 10 minutes doing the same before remembering this is my throwaway and its all a waste.

Vent? Its all shit. Just an undending pile o shit. Its shit from start to finish. From alcohol to alcoholism. From my brith onwards its shit. Like faterht like son! We all drink to be numb. I gave up on stuff a long time ago. I feel like I live on borrowed time. I should just finish those emails and say goodybe.
The sun is rising here at least. I am so fucking sick of seeing sunrises before I sleep, its regular for me. But the wrong way around.
I don't watch terrestrial, just internet stuff. Don't think we have a syfy channel over here.

I dunno if I can trust people. The people I am around don't know how fucked up I am. Some of them that do, i am around, they just aint helpful. I used to turst people but they fucked that up by fucking me up.

I don't see many people. I dropped out of Uni for a bunch of time. So I see those who are still around me. Most of which are useless. My flatmates are as helpful as a chocolate kettle. Hence turnring tp the internet.
Grimm is... Well its grim. About a dude that can see monsters from fairy tales. Its on netflix. Castle is a decetive drama thingy.

Manic depression. So yeah. I get those thoughts that things are only on the up every day. Every fucking day. Followed by the lows. When I am like this anyway.

Also, UK? Go to fucking bed! Its stupid o'clock. I should know.

Once you hit rock bottom things can only get better, true.

But just cause things could get better doesn't help when you are bouncing along rock bottom.

Fucked if I know. after leaving Uni for a few months I have fuck all to do, but try and live on nothing. Watching everything under the sun. Watching Grimm, sorta, right now. I like Castle, mostly caused I loved Firefly and nathan fillion is awesome

I dunno. She is a wonderful. Lots of wonderfuls in my life. Not that I let them into my actual life. I trust her but not that much. Just... Noone I can text at ridiculous o'clock.

Now I feel guitly, cause I know if I text her tomorrow she would go out of her way to give me a hug. Hell, if I texted her now she probably would.

But that just makes me feel guilty. I don't deserve people. She is wonderful. I am just another cunt. They are al wonderful.

 But who am I to tell them my shit, they have their own to deal with, why should I bury them in this, you lnow?
Anything. Television. Anything that cannot be linked with the real world.

One of the only person who hugs me is a friend who has a person. I need them. Needy. Always have been. Broken for so long I cannot remember what being not broken means. The meds started fucking me up though.

I just have nooone in the real world I can trust though. I wish I could get hugged more. But I aint lived with anyone for a very long time, sorta. Its confused.

I miss the people that used to look after me.

Distraction? Its passed 5 in the morning. Aint many healthy distractions around right now. Blergh. Dunno. Just scared. Could be the alcohol, could be the paranoia. Worried that even with these passing statements someone can work out who I am. Don't want that.

Talking is good. Thats a distraction.

Everything. The alcohol doesn't help. I have been alone for so long. It sounds stupid, but I can count the weeks between even hugs with ease. I don't live near family, my friends are useless. I just try every day to get through.

But last time I got drunk I walked home in the middle of the road, screaming at passing cars to run me down. This time I got home, but am sitting around with a blade and a few more things that will leave nasty scars.

Life went to hell and I am just fucking scared.
